author: /root
disposition: Harness and preregistration are accepted after exception-cleanup and exact-size admission repairs. A new candidate freeze, independent identity check and eight-row hardware campaign remain required.

scope.excluded: Wave numerical implementation and production readout correctness were reviewed by another agent; this reviewer does not reapprove those sources.

registered_matrix.candidate_identity: Required lowercase 64-hex FTD_AUDIT_CANDIDATE_ID, embedded in each new report.
registered_matrix.identity_boundary: The harness validates identifier shape, not that it matches the current bytes. Independent pre-run manifest/archive verification and post-run reconciliation must bind the identifier to the measured candidate.
registered_matrix.existing_output_behavior: Refuses overwrite; existing profile dates and output names remain unchanged.

other_checks_unchanged: Authoritative ready WASM and expected qualification
Safe clocks and advancing playing state
Correct panel mount before and after actions
gate_comparison.owner_read_accounting: Only standalone ownerRead diagnostic summaries are excluded; nested native calls remain inside inclusive interface callback timing.
gate_comparison.existing_workload_flow: Original scenario load, availability check, warmup, four-state transitions, running-settled wait, sample window and paired actions are unchanged.

probe_contract.default: Without retainTimingSamples the nominal report matches frozen v2 exactly in controlled execution, and no timingSamples property is added.
probe_contract.optional_output: timingSamples.frames and each timingSamples.callbacks[id] are independent Array.slice copies of the collected vectors, with original order preserved.
probe_contract.copy_order: running=false and stoppedAt recorded, existing asynchronous zero-delay drain, existing summary/report construction, optional copies, finally restoration. No new timing collection or callback cadence is introduced.
probe_contract.summary_rule: Nearest rank ceil(n*q)-1 with clipping; sorted-sum mean. Raw frame vectors also reconstruct inverse-mean FPS and >20/>33.4 counts.
probe_contract.cleanup: Report construction and copies are inside try/finally. Restoration runs on raw-copy failure; a nested finally clears the global only when it still refers to this probe, including when restoration itself throws.
probe_contract.async_boundary: As in v2, already installed callback hooks can collect during the existing zero-delay drain after stoppedAt. The copied vectors include exactly the data summarized after that drain. This preserves the existing contract; it is not a new claim that every callback timestamp lies before stoppedAt.
probe_contract.retention_limit: Raw arrays are copied after measurement, so their allocation does not enter the already recorded callback durations or frame summary; report serialization/retention still consumes memory after the window.

findings_and_repairs.finding: New raw-copy failure could bypass restoration and leave hooks, listeners and the global probe installed.
findings_and_repairs.independent_reproduction: Injected failure on the second frames.slice call, after summary creation, left the subscriber wrapped, two listeners active and the global uncleared.
findings_and_repairs.owner_fix: Wrap asynchronous stop/report/copy/return in try/finally; restore and conditionally clear the same global in nested finally.
findings_and_repairs.reaudit: Independent frame-copy and callback-copy failures now reject while restoring hooks/listeners and clearing the probe.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Initial wave-v3 size validation admitted subsets and duplicates despite the single-invocation eight-row registration.
findings_and_repairs.reaudit: Subsets, reverse order, duplicates, extra and invalid sizes reject; legacy profile size options remain accepted.

independent_checks.execution: Controlled Node vm execution of actual current probe source versus the frozen v2 source; timers, DOM and RAF are minimal stubs. No browser or hardware campaign was launched. No permanent test file was added.
boundaries: The controlled probes establish these code paths, not real browser timing.
Arbitrary host restoration functions throwing can still leave partial restoration; the global cleanup is protected and the exception propagates.
Overlapping start/stop transactions are not certified; the registered harness serially awaits stop before starting another measurement.

legacy_compatibility.additive_metadata: The shared report object now includes candidateIdentity, null when no environment value is supplied.
legacy_compatibility.failure_semantics: Exception cleanup is strengthened for all profiles; this is a deliberate recovery-path change, while nominal default probe records remain unchanged.

verified: Exactly Wave Lab/RF preparation across four states and two backend sizes
Intentional lane/zero/availability correctness changes distinguished from optimizations
No inferred performance improvement from source arithmetic changes
Open owner/sample-clock and direct missing-binding boundaries remain explicit
Overlapping implementation test counts are not summed as unique evidence
Requires frozen identity, same thresholds and independent raw-vector reconstruction
Requires log/raw report/transient attachment archive before another Playwright run on either success or failure
No renewal of other seven v2 callback failures or general physical recovery approval
preregistration_review.implementation_results: The program links coordinator-reported 43 integrated Node and five mounted-browser passes; this review did not rerun or independently reapprove those production checks.

remaining_before_hardware: Freeze distinct complete candidate source/archive and snapshots.
Independently verify that identity and require the same value in both reports.
Run the registered eight rows serially and preserve transient outputs before another browser invocation.
Independently reconstruct raw frame/callback/action summaries and verify post-run candidate hashes.
